user-story.text: Open Alarms to inspect current source and service problems, with matching pane and browser title counts.

data-flow.text: Scheduled reporters publish to GitHub. The collector makes a snapshot and the dashboard renders alarms.

alarm-rules.text: Count a source once and prefer freshness over retained health. Snapshot age and refresh failures are separate. Clear counts after recovery.

acceptance.text: Run reporter, collector, user interface and preference checks, then verify current deployed timestamps and mobile layouts.

boundaries.text: Preserve secrets, authorization and chain state. Add no notification channel and change no backend deployment version.
